chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
Regarding the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
He said: "The salat of the believer at night removes what he committed of sin during the day.

key_terms.السَّيِّئَاتِ: sins or bad deeds that are removed
key_terms.الْحَسَنَاتِ: good deeds that erase evil deeds
key_terms.الْمُؤْمِنِ: the believer whose worship is being described
key_terms.بِاللَّيْلِ: at night; indicating the time of this prayer
key_terms.ذَنْبٍ: a sin committed by a person

ai.seo_question: How does the night prayer of a believer remove sins according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the verse by identifying the believer’s night salat as one of the good deeds that remove sins. It highlights the spiritual effect of worship at night in erasing the misdeeds committed during the day.
